description: Faz 8-P2 P2-0B characterization corpus — V1 (compute_raw_from_delta + provenanced_from_raw) vs V2-candidate (measure_task_delta) semantic divergence measurement. Case content is produced by Rust builders (crates/osp-core/tests/common/faz8_p2_cases.rs); this manifest pins each case's serialized-bytes BLAKE3 digest so builder drift is DETECTED (explicit fixture+digest update required). Corpus change is detected by digest verification, not prevented.

divergence_classes.matching_scope: task.predicate.scope and proposal.affected_nodes describe the same node set — subject/value parity but INV-T4 source divergence (V1 Scip override vs V2 TreeSitter axis)
divergence_classes.wide_affected_scope: proposal.affected_nodes is a strict superset of task.predicate.scope — known production-reachable divergence (V1 measures wider centroid). Two families: 001 (base — Q5 vision authority surface closed, GlobalDefault pre-theta reject) and 002 (#92 theta variant — isolated role-bearing new_node opens Q5 theta surface; raw==001 bit-exact intervention purity).
divergence_classes.removed_edge_external_source: removed_edges[*].from references a node outside task.predicate.scope — divergence (V1 folds into affected set). Two families: 001 (base — Q5 closed) and 002 (#92 theta variant — isolated role-bearing new_node; raw==001 bit-exact).
divergence_classes.delta_introduced_subject: task.predicate.scope members are all introduced by the delta — V2 baseline UnavailableAllIntroduced (typed), V1 DefaultFallback (empty positions → RawPosition::default). Two cases: (1) delta-introduced-subject-001 baseline availability divergence; (2) delta-introduced-subject-policy-001 NotCompleted + AcceptImprovement policy/decision divergence (Migration 3 (b) proof — V1 AcceptAsProgress vs V2 Reject).
divergence_classes.direct_per_axis_authority: Concrete V2 per-axis source required_source ile eşleşince predicate completion Completed; legacy V1 projection (uniform Scip) eşleşmeyince SourceInsufficient. Coupling axis, Node(1) scope. V1 legacy projected coupling = Scip; V2 measured = TreeSitter (engine topology_source). 5-case required_source matrisi (None/Scip/TreeSitter/Placeholder/Heuristic). Pozitif-matching kontrolü: required_source=TreeSitter → V2 Completed (MixedPerAxisSources'ta bu dal kaybolur). Threshold Le 0.5 (exact eski fixture, binary exact). affected_nodes:[1] = V1 legacy measurement selector. Evidence: predicate completion (PredicateSet::evaluate_completion) — task/mainline/witness completion iddiası DEĞİL.
divergence_classes.mixed_per_axis_sources: Mixed aggregate measured source — concrete authority şartını karşılayamaz, declaration requirement olarak talep edilemez. Cohesion axis, Subgraph[1,2] scope. V2 measured cohesion source = Mixed (aggregate [Scip(node1 cohesion=Some), Placeholder(node2 cohesion=None)]); V1 legacy projected = uniform Scip. 6-case required_source matrisi (None/Scip/TreeSitter/Heuristic/Placeholder predicate evaluation + Mixed declaration-validation reject). Mixed gerçek cohesion aggregation hattından doğar (elle enjekte edilmez). DependsOn delta 5 measured axis'te nötr (metric isolation). Threshold Ge 0.50 (measured 0.55, 0.05 marjın). Implementation-scoped: mevcut production measurement path'inde gerçek heterogeneous aggregation yalnız cohesion axis'i üzerinden üretilebilir.

cases.description: Production-reachable structural topology üzerinde V1 legacy DefaultFallback projection ile V2 candidate fail-closed projection arasında migration-relevant policy/decision divergence. NotCompleted + AcceptImprovement: V1 → loss_before > loss_after → improved → AcceptAsProgress (TrajectoryCheckpoint, Held); V2 → loss_before=loss_after → improved=false → Reject (NotApplied, Evaluated). Migration 3 (b) hipotezi kanıtlandı.
cases.notes: Migration 3 (b) policy/decision divergence PROVEN. Case geometrisi: reciprocal Imports edges (Ce=1, Ca=1 → instability 0.5, max_instability=0.85 hard-cap altında) + preferred_vector (0.8, 0.5, 0.5) + Coupling>=0.7 (measured 0.5 → NotCompleted) + AcceptImprovement policy + allow_progress_checkpoint=true. Counter-fixture (min_improvement_delta=1.0) V1 AcceptAsProgress'in improvement kaynaklı olduğunu kanıtlar. INV-T4 provenance divergence da V1 uniform Scip vs V2 engine-native per-axis olarak observable.
